note: 'BCV announced its first investment in the company in November 2021, leading Noteable's $21 million Series A round' (the firm's post, 2022-01-12). The June 2020 Form D the band read is Wing's seed, filed while Aaref Hilaly sat on the board before he joined BCV in August 2020.

BCV's $5.2M round of March 2012 (Ben Holzman, the Form D) followed the company's $600K seed from Google Ventures, Battery and Flybridge ('Tracelytics Raises $600K', TechCrunch, 2011-11-03, https://techcrunch.com/2011/11/03/web-app-performance-solution-tracelytics-raises-600k-from-google-ventures-battery-flybridge/): the first institutional round after a seed, read as its Series A, so the S2A column does not apply.
